items.quote: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation.
items.claim: Moses set up the tabernacle outside the camp and named it the Tabernacle of the congregation
items.object: the tabernacle, Tabernacle of the congregation
items.place: without the camp, afar off from the camp

items.quote: And it came to pass, that every one which sought the LORD went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.
items.claim: All who sought the LORD went out to the tabernacle of the congregation outside the camp
items.actor: every one which sought the LORD
